title: Chat worker header comment names the wrong model lane
body:
**What it says:** The `coder-worker` header example sets `export CODER_WORKER_MODEL=glm      # the lane this worker runs` (`crates/coder/src/bin/coder-worker.rs:28`).

**What the code does:** The chat worker's shipped config uses `CODER_WORKER_MODEL=gemini` (`deploy/coder-worker-chat.env.example:61`), the default lane is Gemini (`crates/coder/src/generate.rs:118`), and every turn asks Space Bunny Alpha first. A reader copying the example gets the GLM lane, which is not what the chat runs. `crates/coder/src/router/personalize.rs:23` and `docs/deployment/chat-worker.md:145` also call the gateway's `glm` lane the one used for personalization without saying it is not the chat model.

**Fix:** Change the example to `gemini`, and add a line that the chat also asks the OpenRouter primary first. Re-check the other two mentions.
